Is Technology Making Us Lazy?

Communication is quick and easy now. But should some things still be personal? We asked four people.

JIN. I'm really into Instagram. It's especially useful for birthdays. When I check my feed I can see who's celebrating, so I never forget. And when somebody has big news — a new baby, a new job — I can write a comment straight away. My grandmother says a card means more. She's probably right, but she also forgets my birthday every year.

JULIE. I absolutely hate it when friends cancel by text. It's so rude. I'm waiting for a message right now, actually. I asked my friend about the cinema this morning and she wrote not sure, I'll let you know. That means she's cancelling. It always means she's cancelling. I'd much prefer a phone call — at least then you have to explain.

MARC. I'm living in Canada this year and I'm writing a blog about it. Fifty separate emails every week was too much, so now I write one post and everyone can read it. My mother still emails me separately, of course. She particularly likes to ask questions I have already answered in the blog.

GABRIEL. I put all my photos on Instagram because people leave comments. I'm an artist, so I post my new work and I say where people can see it. Sometimes my followers come to a show, and it's great to meet them — but I'm quite shy, so I prefer to communicate through pictures.

2

Grammar · present simple and present continuous

TUSHUNTIRISH — PRESENT SIMPLE VA PRESENT CONTINUOUS

Ikkala zamon ham hozirgi vaqt haqida gapiradi. Farqi — vaziyat qancha davom etishida.

A Present simple — odatlar va kundalik ishlar. I send a text when I plan something. · She calls her mother every Sunday.

B Present simple — his-tuygʻular va doimiy holatlar. I like putting photos on my blog. · He lives in Tashkent.

C Present continuous — aynan hozir boʻlayotgan ish. I'm waiting for her text. · Listen — somebody's calling you.

D Present continuous — shu kunlardagi vaqtinchalik ish. She's writing a blog this year. · I'm living in Canada at the moment.

Odatda continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydigan feʼllar: like · love · hate · prefer · want · need · know · understand · believe · mean · seem. I know him deng, hech qachon I am knowing him emas.

Present simple — oddiy hozirgi zamon

Present continuous — davomli hozirgi zamon

I usually text my friends. (odat)

I'm waiting for a reply. (aynan hozir)

She lives in Almaty. (doimiy)

She's living in Almaty this year. (vaqtinchalik)

I like getting postcards. (his-tuygʻu)

I am liking postcards. ✗

Do you use Instagram?

Are you using it right now?

DIQQAT — ZAMONLARDAGI XATOLAR

Uchta narsa notoʻgʻri ketadi, uchinchisi esa eng uzoq saqlanib qoladigani:

1 Odat uchun continuous. ✗ I am usually texting my friends. → ✓ I usually text my friends.

2 Aynan hozirgi ish uchun simple. ✗ Wait — I wait for her message. → ✓ I'm waiting for her message.

3 Holat feʼli continuous shaklda. ✗ I am knowing him for two years. → ✓ I've known him for two years. · ✗ I am wanting a coffee. → ✓ I want a coffee.

Yana bitta kichik xato: ✗ She's living in Almaty since 2020. — since va for bilan boshqa zamon kerak. Continuous ni this year, at the moment, this week uchun saqlang.

Vocabulary · adverbs

TUSHUNTIRISH — RAVISHLAR

Ikki xil ravish, ikki xil vazifa.

A Daraja ravishlari — kuchliroq: really · especially · particularly · absolutely · completely · totally · I absolutely hate it. · It's especially useful.

B Daraja ravishlari — kuchsizroq: quite · pretty · fairly · a bit · slightly · I'm quite shy. · It's pretty hot here.

C Takrorlanish ravishlari: always (100%) · normally · usually · often · sometimes · rarely · hardly ever · never (0%)

D Qayerga qoʻyiladi: asosiy feʼldan oldin — I rarely call. · be dan keyin — She's always late. · always va never odatda gap boshida kelmaydi.

Ehtiyot boʻling: absolutely · completely · totally kuchli soʻzlar bilan keladi — absolutely hate deyiladi, absolutely like emas.

Kuchliroq

Kuchsizroq

I really like it.

I quite like it.

It's especially useful for birthdays.

It's fairly useful.

I absolutely hate cancelling by text.

I'm a bit annoyed.

I particularly enjoy getting letters.

It's pretty good.

HOW I KEEP IN TOUCH
